checks.subject: Warning display boundary
checks.result: productWarning is invoked only while rendering; input/state/persisted warnings remain original strings. React text rendering does not interpret parameter HTML.

checks.subject: Parameter substitution
checks.result: A single replacement callback substitutes known placeholders. Placeholder-like text, Chinese, HTML and replacement metacharacters inside values remain literal; unknown messages remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

checks.subject: Dynamic translation sources

checks.result: No t() calls found; separate calls after locale changes use the active locale. This static scan is not a proof about every event-state lifetime.
